==Block Stat Multipliers==
When you're above certain stages, all block's health and armor are multiplied. There is no increase to fragment gain or exp. These increases limit the highest reachable stage.
{| class="wikitable text-align-center"
!Stage !! HP Multiplier !! Armor Multiplier
|-
|100 || 2 || 1.5
|-
|150 || 2 || 1
|-
|200 || 2 || 1.5
|-
|250 || 2 || 1.5
|-
|300 || 4 || 2.25
|-
|350 || 2 || 1.5
|-
|400 || 2 || 1.5
|-
|450 || 2 || 1.5
|-
|500 || 2 || 1.5
|}

===Boss Floors===
Boss floors always have a fixed layout and aren’t procedurally generated; each one contains 24 blocks.
